domains.name: Design and develop database solutions
subtopics: Design and implement tables including data types, indexes, and columnstore indexes
Design and implement specialised tables including in-memory, temporal, external, ledger, and graph
Design and implement JSON columns and indexes
Design and implement constraints including PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY, UNIQUE, CHECK, and DEFAULT
Design and implement SEQUENCES and partitioning for tables and indexes
Create views, scalar and table-valued functions, stored procedures, and triggers
Write common table expressions and queries using window functions
Write queries using JSON functions, regular expressions, and fuzzy string matching functions
Write graph queries using the MATCH operator, correlated queries, and error handling
Enable and configure GitHub Copilot and Copilot in Fabric, including MCP tool options and instruction files

domains.name: Secure, optimize, and deploy database solutions
subtopics: Design and implement data encryption including Always Encrypted and column-level encryption
Design and implement dynamic data masking, row-level security, and object-level permissions
Implement secure database access including passwordless, and implement auditing
Secure model endpoints with managed identity, and secure GraphQL, REST, and MCP endpoints
Recommend database configurations and preserve integrity with isolation levels and concurrency controls
Evaluate query performance using execution plans, DMVs, Query Store, and Query Performance Insight
Identify and resolve query performance issues including blocking and deadlocks
Design a testing strategy and manage reference data, source control, and secrets for SQL Database Projects
Detect schema drift, deploy changes, and implement deployment pipeline controls
Configure Data API builder entities and endpoints, and integrate with Azure Monitor, CDC, Change Tracking, and Functions

domains.name: Implement AI capabilities in database solutions
subtopics: Evaluate external models including multimodal, multilanguage, size, and structured output
Create and manage external models
Choose an embedding maintenance method including triggers, Change Tracking, Functions, Logic Apps, CDC, and CES
Identify which columns to include in embeddings and design chunking
Generate embeddings
Choose between full-text, semantic vector, and hybrid search, and implement full-text search
Design for vector data including the vector data type, vector indexes, and size
Use vector functions including VECTOR_NORMALIZE, VECTOR_DISTANCE, VECTORPROPERTY, and VECTOR_SEARCH
Choose between ANN and ENN, evaluate index types and metrics, and implement vector and hybrid search
Implement reciprocal rank fusion and retrieval-augmented generation using sp_invoke_external_rest_endpoint
